open_points.subject: import_snapshot
open_points.text: import_snapshot: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_snapshot_by_identity of the snapshot_imports repository of that transaction, a SnapshotImportRepository.
open_points.other_text: import_snapshot: [ORCHESTRATION] In the branch of the ACCEPTED member of = models.ImportOutcome, the repository's insert_snapshot MUST be invoked with the snapshot exactly once before the one call of the repository's insert_snapshot_import with the record; duplicate insertion of the same snapshot, retry-on-constraint, upsert, replace, and a second accepted-snapshot write are forbidden.
open_points.question: Must snapshot and import-record writes use insert_snapshot and insert_snapshot_import, or must they instead go through get_snapshot_by_identity?

open_points.subject: import_snapshot
open_points.text: import_snapshot: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_snapshot_by_identity of the snapshot_imports repository of that transaction, a SnapshotImportRepository.
open_points.other_text: import_snapshot: [PROVENANCE] For a new accepted publication MUST create and insert one fresh ApprovedEstimateSnapshot, then insert a fresh record with the ACCEPTED member of = models.ImportOutcome referencing that exact snapshot_id; for equal fingerprint replay MUST insert a fresh record with its IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY member referencing the exact existing snapshot without inserting a snapshot; for differing fingerprint replay MUST insert a fresh record with its INTEGRITY_CONFLICT member and no snapshot_id and MUST NOT insert or alter a snapshot.
open_points.question: Must the required snapshot and import-record insertions use their repository insertion operations, or must every such write go through the read-only get_snapshot_by_identity operation?

open_points.subject: import_snapshot
open_points.text: import_snapshot: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_snapshot_by_identity of the snapshot_imports repository of that transaction, a SnapshotImportRepository.
open_points.other_text: import_snapshot: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST compute one fingerprint and occurred_at per attempt; authentication failures and non-catalog infrastructure failures MUST re-raise without persistence, while the archived, unknown or out-of-scope and content-validation rejections and every outcome of = models.ImportOutcome MUST each append exactly one fresh immutable SnapshotImportRecord plus exactly one audit with the SNAPSHOT_IMPORT member of = models.AuditAction, appended with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, atomically and commit once.
open_points.question: Must the audit write use append_audit and the transaction's audit repository, or must it go through get_snapshot_by_identity on SnapshotImportRepository?
